Do NOT use: ".", "..", "~", "./folder", "../folder" or any relative paths. Ensure the path exists and is accessible before calling this tool. NOTE: When server is started with --claude flag, this parameter is ignored and a global user directory is used instead.

taskId.description: ID of the task to research

researchAreas.description: Specific areas to research (auto-generated if not provided)

saveToMemories.description: Whether to save research findings to memories

checkExistingMemories.description: Whether to check existing memories first

tools.description: Guides the AI agent to perform web research for a task identified by taskId, with intelligent research suggestions and optional automatic storage of findings in memories. Optional parameters: researchAreas (specific areas to research; auto-generated if omitted), saveToMemories (default true), checkExistingMemories (default true) to check existing memories first, and researchDepth (quick, standard, or comprehensive; default standard). Data is accessed under the given working directory unless the server was started with the --claude flag, in which case a global user directory is used and workingDirectory is ignored.

tools.name: generate_research_queries

workingDirectory.description: The full absolute path to the working directory where data is stored. MUST be an absolute path, never relative. Windows: "C:\Users\username\project" or "D:\projects\my-app". Unix/Linux/macOS: "/home/username/project" or "/Users/username/project". Do NOT use: ".", "..", "~", "./folder", "../folder" or any relative paths. Ensure the path exists and is accessible before calling this tool. NOTE: When server is started with --claude flag, this parameter is ignored and a global user directory is used instead.

taskId.description: ID of the task to generate research queries for

includeAdvanced.description: Include advanced search operators and techniques

targetYear.description: Target year for recent information (default: current year)

tools.description: Generates targeted web search queries for researching a task identified by taskId. Optional parameters: queryTypes to select query categories (implementation, best_practices, troubleshooting, alternatives, performance, security, examples, tools), includeAdvanced (default false) to include advanced search operators and techniques, and targetYear (default 2026) for recent information. Data is read from the given working directory unless the server was started with the --claude flag, in which case a global user directory is used and workingDirectory is ignored.

tools.name: create_entities

observations.description: An array of observation contents associated with the entity

allowOverwrite.description: When true, existing entities with the same name are updated instead of skipped

defaultEntityType.description: Fallback entity type for entities that omit entityType

defaultObservations.description: Fallback observations for entities that omit observations

tools.description: Creates multiple new entities in the knowledge graph. Each entity has a required name and optional entityType and observations (array of observation strings). Optional top-level parameters: allowOverwrite (when true, existing entities with the same name are updated instead of skipped), defaultEntityType (fallback for entities omitting entityType), and defaultObservations (fallback for entities omitting observations).

tools.name: create_relations

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

tools.description: Creates multiple new relations between entities in the knowledge graph. Each relation requires from (start entity name), to (end entity name), and relationType. Relations should be written in active voice.

tools.name: add_observations

entityName.description: The name of the entity to add the observations to

contents.description: An array of observation contents to add

tools.description: Adds new observations to existing entities in the knowledge graph. Each entry requires entityName (the target entity) and contents (an array of observation strings to add).

tools.name: delete_entities

entityNames.description: An array of entity names to delete

tools.description: Deletes multiple entities from the knowledge graph by name (entityNames array), along with their associated relations.

tools.name: delete_observations

entityName.description: The name of the entity containing the observations

observations.description: An array of observations to delete

tools.description: Deletes specific observations from entities in the knowledge graph. Each deletion entry requires entityName (the entity containing the observations) and observations (an array of observation strings to delete).

tools.name: delete_relations

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

relations.description: An array of relations to delete

tools.description: Deletes multiple relations from the knowledge graph. Each relation requires from (start entity name), to (end entity name), and relationType.

tools.name: read_graph
tools.description: Reads and returns the entire knowledge graph. Takes no parameters.

tools.name: search_nodes

query.description: The search query to match against entity names, types, and observation content

tools.description: Searches for nodes in the knowledge graph using a required query, matched against entity names, entity types, and observation content.

tools.name: open_nodes

names.description: An array of entity names to retrieve

tools.description: Opens specific nodes in the knowledge graph by their names, supplied as a required names array of entity names to retrieve.

tools.name: update_entities

name.description: The name of the entity to update

entityType.description: The updated type of the entity

observations.description: The updated array of observation contents

tools.description: Updates multiple existing entities in the knowledge graph. Each entry requires name (the entity to update) and may include entityType (updated type) and observations (updated array of observation contents).

tools.name: update_relations

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

tools.description: Updates multiple existing relations in the knowledge graph. Each relation requires from (start entity name), to (end entity name), and relationType.
